In this study, urban soundscapes containing combined noise sources were evaluated through field
surveys and laboratory experiments.The effect of water sounds on masking urban noises was then
examined in order to enhance the soundscape perception. Field surveys in 16 urban spaces were
conducted through soundwalking to evaluate the annoyance of combined noise sources. Synthesis
